clue.text: Funny smell, primarily rotten eggs, engulfing us

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the opening letter of the next word is used
to engulf is to swallow up, so one piece closes round another

blocks.note: hum is British slang for a bad smell
eggs look like the letter O, two of them here
the first letter of rotten
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone finds the reek of rotten eggs around them amusing.
explanation.walkthrough: Hum is British slang for a stink. Eggs are O-shaped, so they stand for a pair of that letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Humorous is a direct synonym for funny, describing something that causes laughter.
